sources.name: CDC respiratory forecast hubs
sources.publisher: CDC — FluSight, COVID-19 and RSV Forecast Hubs
sources.description: Official weekly Minnesota and U.S. target data used by CDC forecasting: laboratory-confirmed hospital admissions reported to NHSN, and the share of emergency department visits for flu, COVID-19 and RSV from the National Syndromic Surveillance Program (NSSP). Also CDC ensemble forecasts 0–3 weeks ahead.
sources.geography: Minnesota statewide; United States for comparison
sources.attribution: CDC NHSN and NSSP via the CDC FluSight, COVID-19 and RSV Forecast Hubs
